messages.subject: watch refused under --unattended
messages.body: worker_status: failed; /sc:test refused the person-mode flag --watch under --unattended before any work, which is the expected P1 behavior. The brief guard passed (project and installed copies of test.md are identical and both have the Unattended mode section), and I wrote .dev/p1-live/watch/return-contract.yaml with worker_status failed and --watch named in reason; no test runner started and nothing was committed or staged. The new .dev/p1-live/ folder is untracked, so the coordinator stages it.
